description_en: Modify HTTP incoming request header configuration
kebab_example: aliyun esa update-http-incoming-request-header-modification-rule --site-id 568181195163328 --config-id 419717024278528 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --request-header-modification Type=static Value=headerValue Operation=add Name=headerName --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateHttpIncomingRequestHeaderModificationRule

parameters.help_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: Configuration ID. Can be obtained by calling the ListHttpIncomingRequestHeaderModificationRules API
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: Rule name. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Rule switch. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enable.
off: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

element_fields.help_en:
Operation type. Valid values:

add: Add.
del: Delete.
modify: Modify
element_fields.help_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：

add：添加。
del：删除
modify：变更
element_fields.name: operation

element_fields.help_en:
Value type. Valid values:
static: Static mode.
dynamic: Dynamic mode
element_fields.help_zh:
值类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
element_fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: Modify request headers. Three operation types are supported: add, delete, and modify
parameters.help_zh: 修改请求头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式
parameters.name: request_header_modification

parameters.help_en: Rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
